title: Discover technical context through the CLI
statement: As an Architect or Developer directing AI work, I can query Systems, Components, data entities, their relationships, code, and usages so the AI can identify reusable entities and the relevant code subset before exploring raw source.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Public queries return discoverable System, Component, and data-entity identities, descriptions, explicit proposal/existence information, and code-reference health.
Starting from a System or data-model entry, public queries expose the relevant Component/data-entity relationships and exact code references so a caller can identify and select a relevant subset.
Queries expose implementation-deck usages and their originating Items so a caller can find existing feature precedent.
Query results distinguish missing evidence or links from confirmed absence and identify historical, stale, or conflicted records instead of presenting them as current facts.
Public queries can filter proposed entities across Systems, Components, and data entities, returning their stable identities and the explicit state used for the filter.
Public queries can filter entities introduced relative to a specified comparison baseline and head independently of proposed status, including newly implemented entities.
Proposed and new filters can be constrained to the relevant design, feature, or comparison; results expose the declared links establishing scope rather than including unrelated application proposals.
